# Meridian Quality Management Professionals (MEQMP)

> ISO 9001:2015 certified consultancy founded in 2005, providing advisory, training, compliance, sustainability and corporate wellbeing services across the Middle East, Asia and North America. Head office in Dammam, Saudi Arabia; offices in Bahrain, Pakistan and Canada. First TVTC Foreign Registered Training Center in Saudi Arabia. Part of the Gulf Capital holding group.

## Key facts
- Founded: 2005
- Certification: ISO 9001:2015
- Head office: Ground Floor, Building 9, Askan District, Dammam, Saudi Arabia
- Bahrain office: Office 09, LMC Building 852, Road 3618, Block 436, Al Seef, Bahrain
- Pakistan office: 69 CCA, Sector A, DHA Phase 9, Lahore, Pakistan
- Canada: serving clients across North America
- Phone: +966 50 939 4640 | Email: info@meqmp.com
- Learning platform (LMS): https://meridian-lms-beta.vercel.app/
- Track record: 530+ consultancies, 2,500+ trainings, 10,000+ professionals served
- Lead auditors: IRCA-certified; Aramco- and NEOM-approved
- Training accreditations: CCL Canada, Highfield, Saaya; TVTC registered
- Leadership: Asim Baig (CEO), Ameenudeen Ansari (Senior Management Consultant), Kamran Rizvi (Strategic Advisor), Shayan Arshad (QHSE & Food Safety Consultant)

## Services
- [Advisory](https://meqmp.com/services/advisory): Lean Six Sigma, supply chain, project & change management, process reengineering, ISO 27001/42001, oil & gas (API Q1/Q2), HSE, food safety, facilities management.
- [Compliance](https://meqmp.com/services/compliance): gap assessment, implementation, internal audit and certification for ISO 9001, 14001, 45001, 27001, 22000, 50001, 41001, 31000, 37001, 20121, 42001, 17020/17021/17025 and API Q1/Q2.
- [Sustainability](https://meqmp.com/services/sustainability): ESG reporting (GRI, SASB, SDG, TCFD), LEED, Mostadam (Saudi Vision 2030), EcoVadis, life cycle analysis, ISO 14064 carbon footprint, green building advisory, ISO 50001, energy audits.
- [Trainings](https://meqmp.com/trainings): ISO lead & internal auditor courses, Lean Six Sigma Green/Black Belt, Train the Trainer, Business Continuity, Aramco Schedule Q, PMP/RMP exam prep, OSHA 10/30, fire safety, first aid/CPR/AED.
- [Corporate Wellbeing](https://meqmp.com/services/corporate-wellbeing): licensed counselling, 24/7 multilingual hotlines (10+ languages), psychological surveys, mindfulness training, LMS e-learning, AI health tools, HR analytics.

## Industries
Oil & gas, petrochemicals, infrastructure, telecom, supply chain & logistics, manufacturing, healthcare & pharma, insurance & banking, education, packaging, hospitality, construction, public sector, food & beverage.
